hello! lots of things have been going on behind the scenes, thought you all would appreciate knowing what's been going on.
  • webmaster's corner has been completely revamped! i have shucked the ramblings out the window in favor of a better layout (and one less thing i feel the need to update constantly) and a new "about me" tab.
